# Actor Arsenal - LLMs.txt
# A DOOM-themed portfolio site for Apify Actors
# Built by John Rippy

## About This Site
Actor Arsenal is a retro gaming-inspired portfolio showcasing 240 Apify Actors. The site features a DOOM aesthetic with authentic sounds, CRT effects, and playable DOOM integration.

## Site Purpose
- Showcase Apify Actor collection (scrapers, APIs, MCP servers, social media tools)
- Demonstrate creative web development skills
- Provide an interactive, nostalgic gaming experience
- Play DOOM in-browser via js-dos

## Actor Categories
- Scrapers: Web scraping tools for various platforms (Yelp, BBB, Zillow, etc.)
- MCP Servers: Model Context Protocol integrations for AI agents
- Social Media: Posters and scrapers for LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, etc.
- SEO Tools: Technical SEO auditors, citation checkers, schema generators
- APIs: Sports data, sentiment analysis, recipe APIs
- Research: Industry research, competitor monitoring, lead enrichment

## Key Pages
- / (index.html) - Main landing page with DOOM HUD and actor grid
- /cards.html - Card-based view of all actors
- /play-doom.html - Full DOOM game playable in browser
- /actors/*.html - Individual actor detail pages (240)

## Technologies Used
- HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- js-dos (WebAssembly DOOM port)
- DOOM authentic sound effects
- Press Start 2P font for retro gaming aesthetic
- CRT scanline and blood vignette effects
